messages:
shipit-bot: PROD launch window open — starting rollout to production (us-west-2). tag: v3.6.0-release. commit: 7f4d2a9. Change window: 2026-03-21 22:00-23:00 UTC. Rolling 10% -> 100% over ~10m. Initiated by @release-manager. Ops lead: @alex. FYI @jen
alex: ack. watching infra and load. smoke checklist kicked off.
maya: quick canary check — responses look good, P50 ~42ms, no errors in traces.
ops-alerts: CPU on inference-pool-01 spiked to 78% during canary ramp, recovered to 43% within 90s. Alert auto-resolved.
shipit-bot: Traffic routed to 25% — health checks OK. Autoscaler added +2 replicas to inference pool.
alex: added a temporary fallback route in routing-config pointing to v3.5-quant for model-fallback; pinned in case of regression.
maya: running a short eval sweep on the baseline prompt set, no quality regressions observed so far.
ops-alerts: Disk I/O spikes on db-hotspot flagged, mitigation applied (IO throttle). No user-facing errors.
release-manager: Holding at 50% for a 5m observation window to validate billing and error metrics.
jen: release notes draft is published: https://internal/release/3.6.0 — will add customer-facing blurb after final.
shipit-bot: Hold complete. Promoting to 100% now. Rolling finalizers: cache warm, kv-store primed.
shipit-bot: Promotion complete — rolled to 100% in us-west-2. commit 7f4d2a9. Deploy finished at 2026-03-21 22:07:59 UTC. Runbook checks: smoke tests ✅, canary metrics ✅, rollout health ✅. :shipit:
alex: smoke tests green, latency and error budgets within target. No rollback needed.
maya: monitoring APM for next 30m, will flag if anything drifts.
release-manager: Closing window — post-deploy actions: monitor errors, notify support and docs to publish release note link. Thanks all for the quick triage and checks. :tada:
